```yaml
name: Advanced Translation Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ develop, main ]
    paths:
      - 'lib/l10n/**'
      - '.github/scripts/translate_toolkit_check.py'
      - '.github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py'
      - '.github/TRANSLATION_CHECK_PROMPT.md'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  translation-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install translate-toolkit
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install gettext

      - name: Run translate-toolkit quality checks
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/translate_toolkit_check.py

      - name: Run advanced translation checks
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py

      - name: Validate ARB files format
        run: |
          find lib/l10n -name "*.arb" -exec flutter pub run intl_utils:generate {} \;

      - name: Check for brand name consistency
        run: |
          # Verify brand names are not translated
          grep -r "Nutri-Score\|NOVA\|Open Food Facts\|Open Prices" lib/l10n/ --exclude-dir=__pycache__ --exclude="*.pyc" || echo "No brand name translation found"
          
          # Verify URLs are not translated
          grep -r "prices.openfoodfacts.org" lib/l10n/ --exclude-dir=__pycache__ --exclude="*.pyc" || echo "No URL translation found"
```
